result.reason: The operative language adopts a mutual USD 1,000,000 floor and a trailing-12-month amount-based cap, but it does not establish the required mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, specify the required uncapped carve-outs, or clarify that Customer payment obligations are not damages. “Excluded Claims” is undefined in the supplied language, and the margin comment cannot create those carve-outs. It therefore does not demonstrably meet either the preferred or fallback position. The amendment is otherwise targeted and generally preserves the clause’s unrelated intent, although “all amounts” is broader and less precise than the playbook’s “fees.”
